_note: Simple recipes for the rule-based fallback. Ingredient names are matched against the inventory in code. Salt, oil, and water are assumed.

recipes.title: Spinach omelette
steps: Wilt the spinach in a pan with a little oil.
Beat the eggs with a pinch of salt and pour them over.
Cook until set, fold, and serve.

recipes.title: Egg fried rice
steps: Cook the rice if it isn't already (day-old rice is best).
Scramble the eggs in oil and set them aside.
Fry the rice and any veggies in oil, stir the eggs back in, and salt to taste.

recipes.title: Banana pancakes
steps: Mash the bananas and whisk in the eggs.
Pour small rounds into an oiled pan over medium heat.
Flip when bubbles form and cook the other side.

recipes.title: Chicken and rice
steps: Season the chicken with salt and brown it in oil.
Cook the rice; add any veggies near the end.
Cook the chicken all the way through (165°F inside) and serve over the rice.

recipes.title: Banana smoothie
steps: Blend the bananas with the milk and any extras until smooth.

recipes.title: Yogurt bowl
steps: Spoon the yogurt into a bowl and top it with sliced fruit.

recipes.title: Garlicky sauteed spinach
steps: Warm oil in a pan with sliced garlic if you have it.
Add the spinach and a pinch of salt and stir until just wilted.

recipes.title: Spinach pasta
steps: Boil the pasta in salted water.
Wilt the spinach (and any veggies) in oil.
Toss everything together with a splash of pasta water.

recipes.title: Grilled cheese
steps: Put the cheese between two slices of bread.
Toast in an oiled or buttered pan until golden on both sides.

recipes.title: Quesadillas
steps: Fill tortillas with cheese and any extras (cook any meat first).
Toast in a pan until the cheese melts, then slice.

recipes.title: Rice and beans
steps: Cook the rice.
Warm the beans with any onion, peppers, or garlic in oil, and salt to taste.
Serve the beans over the rice.

recipes.title: Tofu stir-fry
steps: Cook the rice.
Press and cube the tofu, then fry it in oil until golden.
Add the veggies, stir-fry until tender, and serve over the rice.

recipes.title: Tomato egg scramble
steps: Soften the chopped tomatoes in oil with a pinch of salt.
Pour in the beaten eggs and gently scramble until just set.

recipes.title: French toast
steps: Whisk the eggs (and milk if you have it).
Soak the bread slices, then cook in an oiled pan until golden on both sides.

recipes.title: Roasted potatoes
steps: Chop the potatoes and any veggies, toss with oil and salt.
Roast at 425°F, flipping once, until crisp.

recipes.title: Big salad
steps: Chop everything, toss with oil and a pinch of salt, and eat right away (cook any chicken or eggs first).
